comparisons.peer_topic: Operating lease accounting policy and expense
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm recognizes right-of-use assets and lease liabilities for leases longer than one year, with operating lease costs amounting to $473 million in 2024, $484 million in 2023, and $462 million in 2022, while variable lease costs and excess occupancy expenses were not material.
comparisons.comparison: Both C and GS disclose specific operating lease costs incurred during fiscal 2024. While C's disclosure focuses on a single future commitment for a new lease ($255 million over 15 years commencing April 2025), GS provides the actual expense recognized in 2024 ($473 million) and notes that variable lease costs were not material, similar to how C's disclosed commitment consists of fixed payments.

sentences.text: At December 31, 2024, the Company had a future lease commitment scheduled to commence in April 2025 with fixed lease payments (undiscounted) totaling approximately $255 million over a 15-year lease term.
Operating lease costs were $473 million for 2024, $484 million for 2023 and $462 million for 2022.
Variable lease costs, which are included in operating lease costs, were not material for each of 2024, 2023 and 2022.

comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 31, 2024, the Firm had additional future operating lease commitments of $887 million that were signed but had not yet commenced, with commencement dates between 2025 and 2027 and lease terms up to 21 years.
comparisons.comparison: Both C and JPM disclose future operating lease commitments that have been signed but not yet commenced as of December 31, 2024. C discloses a $255 million commitment commencing April 2025, while JPM discloses $887 million in such commitments with commencement dates between 2025 and 2027. Both represent obligations for leases not yet on the balance sheet as operating lease liabilities because they have not commenced.

sentences.text: At December 31, 2024, the Company had a future lease commitment scheduled to commence in April 2025 with fixed lease payments (undiscounted) totaling approximately $255 million over a 15-year lease term.
In addition to the table above, as of December 31, 2024, the Firm had additional future operating lease commitments of $887 million that were signed but had not yet commenced.
These operating leases will commence between 2025 and 2027 with lease terms up to 21 years.
